newsitem.title: USA: Emcore stake held by Hakuto.
newsitem.headline: Emcore stake held by Hakuto.

text.p: Hakuto Co Ltd said Tuesday it holds a 6.7 percent stake in Emcore Inc, or 367,368 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company did not say when they purchased the shares, but spent $3.82 million to buy them.

Hakuto said it holds the stake for investment purposes and in order to strengthen its working relationship with Emcore. Hakuto distributes some of Emcore's products in several Asian countries, the filing said.
Emcore, based in Somerset, New Jersey, develops compound semiconductor materials.
Hakuto, based in Tokyo, Japan, is in the business of importing and distributing electronic, scientific, manufacturing and chemical products.
